author: Claude Code (sole code writer)
exposure: Prior train-result exposure: the implementer saw the complete Task010 train comparison and per-event changes (including PUMP-04 SENSOR_NOISE_SPIKES detected by B1 as SENSOR_CALIBRATION_SHIFT) before implementing. All Q/U thresholds were fixed by the coordinator packet; no raw channel values were inspected to set them. Phase 1 read no benchmark telemetry, snapshots or labels.

data_scope.allowed_shared_static: assets.csv parsed then filtered to train rows; shared parquet read through train predicates (asserted); benign table filtered to train
forbidden: test PUMP-10..12 telemetry, snapshots, predictions, labels
rewriting Task010 or any earlier result/release

emission: unchanged causal B1 (k=6, persistence 15, 24 h first-day empirical reference, 12 h refractory per B1 type), PYTHONHASHSEED=0 at start; only class/type/evidence/action/channel change

candidates.Q1: isolated-spread rule; exactly one eligible source -> SENSOR/SENSOR_NOISE_SPIKES with suspected_channel; else exact B1
candidates.Q2: Q1 plus extreme-to-spread ratio >= 4.0 on the same source
candidates.U1: Q1; if Q1 abstains AND B1 fault_type == UNKNOWN, unchanged Task010 W1 rule; else exact B1
candidates.U2: Q2 with the same UNKNOWN-only W1 refinement

scope_of_application: Q/U are evaluated at every emitted B1 alert whose B1 type is not COMMUNICATION_LOSS or SENSOR_STUCK (these stay protected). Q may therefore replace a specific B1 machine or sensor cause; W1 in U1/U2 replaces only B1 UNKNOWN.

q_rule.excluded: vibration v/a/c, speed n, valve position vp
q_rule.source_usable: installed in passport channels_available; closed-minute count >= 30; finite mean, finite std > 0, finite spread z (zs_key)
q_rule.coupled: B.COUPLED[key] (vendor list, de-duplicated); usable = installed, count >= 30, finite mean, finite std >= 0 (negative std is invalid, std = 0 is a valid quiet channel), finite spread z
q_rule.coupled_requirement: >= 2 usable coupled channels AND every usable coupled spread z <= 2.0 (signed, no abs); coupled LEVEL deviations ignored
q_rule.spread_z_definition: causal B1 zs_key = (minute std - reference median std) / max(1.4826 MAD, 1e-3 + 0.05 |median|), first-24h steady reference (unchanged causal_b1.py)
q_rule.uniqueness: exactly one eligible source; zero or >1 -> exact B1
q_rule.q2_outlier: finite min/max with min <= mean <= max and max > min; max(|max-mean|, |min-mean|)/std >= 4.0 (closed minute only); descriptive, not a probability
q_rule.confidence: rows re-labelled by Q (or W1 in U1/U2) keep B1's confidence, which is B1's uncalibrated anomaly score for the alert, NOT a confidence estimate for the newly named cause
q_rule.evidence: minute mean/std/count, source spread z, (Q2) extreme/std, every usable coupled channel with spread z, limits text, original B1 type; full numeric detail in rule_detail JSON
q_rule.action: check raw signal, wiring and a reference measurement under comparable operation; sensor failure unconfirmed

u_rule.waveform: Task010 diagnosis_fusion.w1_rule and asset_waveform imported unchanged (latest valid completed snapshot, max age 4 h, first-24h reference >= 2 snapshots, minute speed tol 0.05, reference speed tol 0.10, envelope requested 1-5 kHz / effective 1000-4608 Hz, BPFO ratio >= 4 and gain >= 2, 1x gain >= 2, 2x/1x 0.5)
u_rule.condition: only when the Q rule abstains and B1 fault_type == UNKNOWN

no_learning: nothing is fitted; seven independently replayed train assets (not a learned LOAO)

gates.success: detected>=18, class>=14, false+excess<=6, sensor type+channel>=3, AND (type>=10 OR (type>=9 AND sensor type+channel>=4))
gates.selection: useful diagnoses desc, correct type desc, false+excess asc, simpler candidate Q1<Q2<U1<U2
correctness: control semantic equality to results/causal_b1/predictions_causal_train.csv and expected metrics

prefix replay + future mutation (minute means AND std/min/max of minutes ending after the cut, snapshots completing after the cut) for ALL candidates incl. U1/U2, at every alert, reference end -1/0/+1/+60 s, 3 snapshot completion and age boundaries -1/0/+1 s per asset, 5 random cuts (rng 0), every output column incl. rule_detail
additional std/min/max-only future mutation at every alert for Q1/Q2 (no snapshots)
main prediction hash equals a fresh PYTHONHASHSEED=0 child process

runner.before_scoring: run_provenance.json (manifest/code hashes, train-only input projection hashes, prediction hashes) + raw predictions
runner.attempts: new results/noise_unresolved/run-<UTC>/ per attempt, partial runs preserved; COMPLETED.json blocks a second score

output_schema.diagnosis_source: what produced the EMITTED row: B1, Q1, Q2 or W1
output_schema.rule_detail: JSON for every non-protected row of Q1/Q2/U1/U2: evaluated_noise_rule (the Q rule that was evaluated, even when it abstained), emitted_source (= diagnosis_source), noise_rule_outcome (emitted / abstained_no_source / abstained_ambiguous), eligible count and every examined source with its statistics and coupled spread z. An abstained Q evaluation is never presented as the emitted explanation: the evidence text describes only the emitting rule.
output_schema.waveform_fields: wf_* provenance filled only for U1/U2 (production call computes waveform state); empty for B1/Q1/Q2

review: docs/tasks/011-review-round1.md addressed: main-audit spread mutation for all candidates; negative coupled std invalid; rule_detail field semantics; retained B1 anomaly score
